name: Oyster Soup, Amsterdam Style
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Clean, pick over, chop, and parboil oysters; drain and add to liquor enough water to make one quart liquid.
Brown butter, add flour, and pour on gradually, while stirring constantly, oyster liquor.
Season with salt, paprika, and celery salt, and just before serving add cream.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
